stories.title: Kawhi Leonard Investigation — ESPN Warns Trade Could Push Into 2027

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The NBA's outside law firm has finished fact-finding on the Kawhi Leonard investigation.

But ESPN warns the probe could still push into 2027.

The trade agreed in June. Sanctions on the Clippers are expected. No deadline exists. The clock has no hands. #Raptors #LAClippers

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Kawhi Leonard told reporters he expects the trade to go through before training camp.

Toronto training camp: Sept. 28-29 in Quebec City.

The investigation has been running for 11 months. Kawhi is betting on Sept. The NBA has made no promises. #Raptors

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Investigation
**[HIGH]** Trade agreed June 30: Leonard to Toronto Raptors for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, unprotected 2031 and 2033 first-rounders, 2027 first-round swap, two second-round picks. (Source: Shams Charania / ESPN)
**[HIGH]** Trade paused July 9 when NBA opened cap circumvention investigation. (Source: NBA.com, ESPN)
**[HIGH]** Investigation centers on Clippers funneling ~$28M to Leonard via Aspiration endorsement deal during NBA/league business relationship. (Source: multiple reports)
**[HIGH]** Outside law firm hired by NBA reportedly finished fact-finding around Aug 10. (Source: HoopsHype, ~Aug 10)
**[HIGH]** Leonard owes $50.3M in 2026-27 salary. (Source: multiple contract databases)
**[HIGH]** CBA does not allow player suspension for cap circumvention — Clippers face sanctions, not Leonard. (Source: CBS Sports, ESPN)
**[HIGH]** Leonard publicly stated he expects the trade to be completed before training camp. (Source: HoopsHype/Hoops Rumors Aug 10 report)
**[MEDIUM]** ESPN warned (late July) investigation could drag into 2027 if complications arise. (Source: ESPN)
**[HIGH]** Toronto training camp in Quebec City approximately Sept. 28-29.

stories.title: NBA's Back-to-Back Revolution — Fewest Ever in a Single Season

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The 2026-27 NBA schedule averages 14.2 back-to-back games per team — the lowest ever.

For the first time in league history, no team will play 4 games in 5 days.

Players have been asking for this for years. The schedule finally caught up.

research.facts:
NBA Back-to-Back Reduction
**[HIGH]** 2026-27 schedule averages 14.2 back-to-back games per team — lowest since NBA Cup era began. (Source: NBA.com schedule release Aug 13, CBS Sports)
**[HIGH]** No team will have more than 16 back-to-backs.
**[HIGH]** For first time in NBA history, no team will play four games in five days.
**[HIGH]** No team will play eight games in 12 days.
**[HIGH]** No team will play 18 games in 30 days.
research.sources: Sources: NBA.com official schedule release, CBS Sports, Yahoo Sports schedule breakdown.

research.facts:
Stephen Curry Extension
**[HIGH]** Extension eligibility window opens August 29 — 13 days from today. (Source: ESPN, multiple)
**[HIGH]** Expected deal: 2-year, $136.7 million max extension. (~$68M/year, carrying Curry through age-40 season)
**[HIGH]** Warriors GM Mike Dunleavy Jr. described team as "super aggressive" in retaining Curry. (Source: Bleacher Report)
**[HIGH]** ESPN's Anthony Slater confirmed mutual interest; signing expected as soon as window opens. (Source: ESPN)
**[MEDIUM]** ESPN's Brian Windhorst floated concept of shorter deal for roster flexibility. (Source: ESPN)
**[HIGH]** Without extension, Curry would be an unrestricted free agent in summer 2027 — first time in his career. (Source: multiple)
**[HIGH]** Christmas Day 2026: Nuggets vs. Warriors confirmed on ESPN/ABC. (Source: NBA.com schedule)
**[HIGH]** Warriors finished 37-45 in 2025-26. Curry shot 42% from 3-point range at age 38.
**[HIGH]** Curry earns $65 million in 2026-27 under his current deal (final year).
research.sources: Sources: Bleacher Report, ESPN, Yahoo Sports, Yardbarker, NBA.com.
